quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 earnings deck, segment table (pages 13-14 and 19): Building Automation sales $2,020 million (up 8% organic, segment margin 27.0%), Process Automation & Technology $1,859 million (up 8% organic and 16% reported; margin 22.2%, down 210 bps), Industrial Automation $1,115 million (up 4% organic, down 23% reported; the WWS and PSS businesses were divested in 3Q 2026; margin 18.4%, up 350 bps). Within Industrial Automation, solutions grew 16% organic and products were flat; PA&T aftermarket grew 4% organic (17% reported). Building Automation LTM book-to-bill ~1.05x; Industrial Automation orders up 16% excluding the divestitures, book-to-bill ~1.05x. Total segment sales $4,994 million; GAAP operating income $740 million, a 14.8% operating margin (8.4% in Q3 2025). LTM organic orders growth (page 4 chart): 1% (3Q25), 3% (4Q25), 6% (1Q26), 11% (2Q26), 8% (3Q26).

quarterly_data.quarter: Honeywell IR presentation: Q3 2026 Honeywell Technologies Earnings Presentation (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 earnings deck, stranded-cost slide (page 9): fixed cost as a percent of sales was 36.6% in 2025 and 33.9% in 2026 year to date, with a 2027 target of 31.3% (~500 bps improvement); the slide states ~270 bps improvement year to date 'while increasing R&D investments across all SBGs over same period' and that Honeywell is on track to remove all remaining stranded cost by end of 2026. Footnote: 2025 and 2026 YTD include fixed costs from Quantinuum and the retained corporate assessment previously allocated to aerospace; 2026 YTD and 2027 exclude the acquired Johnson Matthey Catalyst Technologies business.
quarterly_data.figure: fixed cost % of sales 36.6% (2025), 33.9% (2026 YTD), 31.3% (2027 target)
